purpose: Group avatar design exploration; not used as user identity
a: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one premium design contact sheet for ten animal group avatars for a clean white desktop/mobile file-transfer app. These are GROUP icons only, never user avatars. Pure white background, landscape board, exactly TWO ROWS OF FIVE animal heads with generous equal spacing, no text or labels, no UI chrome, no frames, no circular badges. Row 1 left to right: orange tabby cat, fluffy cream sheep, chestnut monkey, floppy-eared beagle dog, soft yellow chick. Row 2: small green lizard, cream alpaca, white rabbit, brown river otter, tawny capybara. Style A: exquisitely designed soft 3D character heads with rounded forms and satin clay-like material, gentle realistic ambient occlusion inside features, restrained natural pastel colors, very subtle studio lighting. Each has a distinct charming face and friendly expression, refined rather than childish. Beautiful coherent proportions, eyes that are small glossy dark beads with tiny highlights, no huge anime eyes. Cat pointed ears, sheep fluffy scalloped wool, monkey rounded ears, dog hanging ears, chick beak, lizard visible little muzzle, alpaca long elegant ears, rabbit tall soft ears, otter broad whiskered muzzle, capybara blunt rectangular nose. Heads only, front-facing with subtle natural asymmetry, all fully contained and readable at 32-48 pixels. NO outlines, no thin line-art, no monochrome, no lifeless geometric diagrams, no clothing, no objects, no hats, no glossy plastic, no strong cast shadows. The ten characters should feel individually art-directed and immediately recognizable, not generic emoji pasted from a library.
b: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a new art-direction contact sheet of TEN premium, expressive animal GROUP AVATARS for a white, Apple-inspired file sharing app. Exactly 2 rows of 5 equally sized front-facing animal HEADS on pure WHITE, ample clean padding; no text, no labels, no UI, no circles, no badge frames, no accessories or bodies. Order: top row orange cat, sheep, monkey, floppy-eared dog, chick; bottom row green lizard, alpaca, rabbit, otter, capybara. Art direction B: charming sculpted 3D emoji-like characters, smooth softly rounded satin polymer forms, highly stylized rather than realistic. NO FUR STRANDS, NO HAIR TEXTURE, NO scales texture. Rich but controlled natural colors, sophisticated subtle gradients and gentle ambient lighting, crisp silhouettes. Faces have clear friendly expressions, eyebrows/cheeks/nostrils shaped thoughtfully, one cat smiles mischievously, sheep gently happy, monkey curious, dog playful, chick cheerful, lizard charming, alpaca serene, rabbit alert, otter friendly, capybara relaxed. Small dark glossy eyes with subtle light reflections, proportionate rather than huge anime eyes. More character and finish than geometric line art, less visual clutter than detailed realism. Apple Memoji-level polished dimensionality, original animal designs, not copied standard emoji. Clear distinctive ears/muzzle/head shapes so every animal is readable at 32px. No heavy outline, no dramatic shadows, no metallic shine, no empty faceless icons, no monochrome.
c: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape contact sheet containing TEN individually art-directed animal GROUP avatar icons for a beautiful white file-transfer app. Two evenly spaced rows of five front-facing head-only portraits, white background, no text, no frames, no UI, no circles or backgrounds behind individual faces. Exact order top row: orange cat, fluffy white sheep, monkey, floppy-eared dog, yellow chick. Bottom row: green lizard, alpaca, rabbit, otter, capybara. Style C: high-end hand-painted digital mascot illustration, expressive rounded silhouettes and carefully designed facial expressions, matte gouache-like colors with extremely subtle smooth shading, limited clean color blocks, medium-weight colored contour accents rather than black outlines. Playful sophistication with hand-crafted personality. Clearly TWO-DIMENSIONAL graphic illustration, not a 3D render and not realistic furry animals. Refined original characters, useful at 32-48px: vivid friendly eyes, tiny nose, recognizable mouth, subtle eyebrows. Color palette mostly natural oranges, ivory, browns, gentle green, warm yellow, with restrained rosy accents; white app stays white, color lives only inside animal icons. Charming asymmetrical smiles and distinctive ear/forehead/muzzle designs, no simplistic faceless geometric line art. Absolutely no accessories, hats, bodies, paws, toys, text, thick dark borders, loud gradients, sticker backplates, drop shadows. Use excellent shapes and balanced negative space, coherent icon family while preserving each animal's distinctive character.
